evidence.content: Hi Reese, I'm comparing two vendor bids for a need-by date of October 1: Northstar ($48,000, 30-day lead) and Cedar ($52,000, 18-day lead), budget $55,000. Do you have any information on security reviews or risk issues for either vendor, or on today's date so I can confirm the latest order date that still meets the lead time? Please reply with only what you know.
The procurement risk analyst knows Northstar has a documented 60-day security review backlog; Cedar has completed the review.
